purpose: Real predicted-action U/I/A/J study on the fixed six-tune/four-selector-held-out EPIC train split

selection_lock.purpose: Tune-only choice before the single held-out selector comparison
selection_lock.selection_metric: macro per-video distinct canonical pair coverage, frac>=0.5
selection_lock.tie_break: prefer current J, then A, I, U
selection_lock.limitations: Only EPIC action coverage is labeled. No FPVSum human F1/label data or full weighted total; global A discards importance when no actions.

recommendation: Retain existing joint defaults. A is the EPIC coverage winner, not a demonstrated full-objective or FPVSum winner.
limitations: ActionFormer trained on these source videos; holdout is for selector decisions only.
Small nonrandom diversity-selected cohort: six tuning, four held-out participants.
No FPVSum F1 or label measurements; no competition weighted total.
Coverage uses a local frac>=0.5 union-overlap convention; official scorer unavailable.

conventions.aggregation: coverage mean on EPIC, F1/label mean on FPVSum, pooled detector AP on EPIC

tune-predicted.command: <ACTIVA>\.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts/run_ablation.py --study tmp/m3/2026-11-17/tune-study.json --review tmp/m3/2026-11-17/study-review.json --official-manifest kit/manifest.csv --coverage-rule frac>=0.5 --output tmp/m3/2026-11-17/tune-predicted.json

conventions.aggregation: coverage mean on EPIC, F1/label mean on FPVSum, pooled detector AP on EPIC

post_evaluation_label_presence_diagnosti.definition: GT class-pair has any detection with same label, irrespective of time; not recall or coverage. Computed after frozen evaluation, never used for further tuning.
